subjects.behavior: Consumes four stage_sfx words before destination dispatch. pitch_select 0/1/2/3 selects direction 0/+1/-1/facing_dir. Calls ft_80087D0C on the scripted ID; passes its result, direction, gobj, behavior, fixed 127/127 and three decoded parameters to lbAudioAx_800263E8, then lbAudioAx_800264E4. Destination 0 writes x2160 with channel 0; 1/2/3/4/5/6 write x214C/x2144/x2150/x2154/x2158/x2148 using player_id+x221F_b4 plus 0x36/0x1E/0x42/0x4E/0x5A/0x2A. Destinations 2/6 skip these calls when x2225_b6 is set except for GameWatch and Samus. Other destination values produce no handle write. Every audio call uses terminal -1. A pitch selector outside 0–3 has no initializing branch for direction.
